bad.title: Every preview is the same deck
bad.text: A title and three bullets in each. Only the accent color changes.

bad.title: Named by color, not by use
bad.text: Blue, Green, Coral and Mono say nothing about a trip slideshow.

bad.title: The photos end up in small boxes
bad.text: Whichever tile people pick, it’s bullets again.
bad.wait: Pick any start to see this.

good.title: Each preview shows a different shape
good.text: A full photo, a question mark, bars. People see the range before reading a word.

good.title: One line on what it’s for
good.text: “Full-page photos, one line of text each” matches the trip slideshow at a glance.

good.title: A wrong pick explains itself
good.text: Pick Pitch, and it says the photos would sit in small boxes.

bad.title: No owner, no last check
bad.text: Nothing hints that this template hasn’t been touched in years.

bad.title: Opens as Budget 2023
bad.text: People’s first sheet starts three years out of date.
bad.wait: Press Use template to see this.

bad.title: The chart is broken on arrival
bad.text: “This chart type is no longer supported” is the first thing people see.
bad.wait: Press Use template to see this.

good.title: An owner and a release check
good.text: Budget team, checked with the October 2026 release. Someone answers for it.

good.title: Opens as Budget 2026
good.text: The year matches today, so people can start filling it in.
good.wait: Press Use template to see this.

good.title: The chart works from the start
good.text: Rent, food, phone and streaming already show as bars.
good.wait: Press Use template to see this.

bad.title: Jane Doe looks like a real name
bad.text: Nothing says it’s an example, so it’s easy to leave in.

bad.title: Headings and content look alike
bad.text: Experience is as clickable as the text under it, so people can’t tell what’s theirs.

bad.title: Example text slips through
bad.text: Press Check after changing one part, and four still hold Jane’s details.

good.title: A dashed border and the word edit
good.text: Each part to change says so in words, not only in color.

good.title: One line names the first step
good.text: Start with your name and the job you want.

good.title: The mark clears once it’s yours
good.text: Change all five parts, and Check says “All parts are yours.”
good.wait: Change every marked part and press Check to see this.

bad.title: New form always opens the gallery
bad.text: People who want a blank form have to go through templates first.

bad.title: Blank hides under More options
bad.text: It takes three clicks to reach an empty form, every time.
bad.wait: Press New form to see this.

bad.title: The clicks pile up
bad.text: Three blank forms cost nine clicks.

good.title: Blank form is a button of its own
good.text: One click, and an untitled form joins the list.

good.title: Templates sit right beside it
good.text: People who want a head start still get the gallery.

good.title: One click per form
good.text: Three blank forms cost three clicks.

bad.title: Four hints open at once
bad.text: Zoom, compare, crop and share all speak up before people do anything.

bad.title: The bubbles cover the tools
bad.text: Crop and Share sit under hints, so a press lands on the hint instead.

bad.title: The count only goes down by hand
bad.text: Hints open: 4 until people close each one.

good.title: The tools start clear
good.text: No hint is open, so the photo and all four buttons are free to use.

good.title: One hint, right after Adjust
good.text: It talks about the Light slider people just opened.

good.title: No hint for a tool already used
good.text: Press Crop, and it opens with no hint because people have used it before.

bad.title: Got it doesn’t stick
bad.text: The hint closes now, but the app forgets the choice.

bad.title: Shown every time the app opens
bad.text: Press Got it and reopen, and it says the hint was shown twice.

bad.title: No way to manage tips
bad.text: Open the app again is the only control, so people can’t turn them off.

good.title: Got it is remembered
good.text: Saved with the account, so the hint stays closed on every device.

good.title: Reopen, and it stays closed
good.text: The count of hints shown stops at 1.

good.title: Show tips again brings them back
good.text: People who closed a hint too fast have one place to find it.

bad.title: The hint sits on Filters
bad.text: It talks about the button while hiding it.

bad.title: Sort is covered too
bad.text: Both toolbar buttons are out of reach while the hint is open.

bad.title: A press lands on the hint
bad.text: Press Filters, and it says Filters is underneath.

good.title: The hint points up at Filters
good.text: It sits below the toolbar, so the button stays in view.

good.title: Filters works with the hint open
good.text: Press it, and the sizes open right away.

good.title: Using it closes the hint
good.text: Sizes 38 to 42 appear, and the hint goes because its job is done.

bad.title: The only place it’s explained
bad.text: Close it, and nothing else says how to drag an event longer.

bad.title: Help leaves it out
bad.text: Three topics, and none is about an event’s length.

good.title: Learn more links to the help
good.text: People see where the full answer lives before closing the hint.

good.title: Help lists it as a topic
good.text: “Change an event’s length” is there, with a keyboard way too.
